# CANDIDATE: TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_ENTRY

**Filed:** 2026-06-28
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge in trendline breakouts by identifying the first bar that breaks out above a descending trendline, and entering a long position. The hypothesis is that this breakout will lead to a continuation of the trend.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using a trendline detection algorithm to identify descending trendlines, and then monitoring the price action for a breakout above the trendline. The entry trigger is the first bar that closes above the trendline.
